name: Costa Rica (1840–1842)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of white, light blue and white, with the seal of the State of Costa Rica, a white star within a circular inscription, in the centre.
history: Adopted on 21 April 1840 under head of state Braulio Carrillo, who reversed the Central American blue-white-blue to white-blue-white and placed the new state seal with a star in the centre to mark Costa Rica's separation from the federation. It was abolished on 20 April 1842 when Carrillo was overthrown by Francisco Morazán.

features.role: seal of the State of Costa Rica
